item.title: The Correspondent: an old discovered pilot from the early days of Benedict and Gaz
item.itunes:title: The Correspondent: an old discovered pilot from the early days of Benedict and Gaz
item.description:
An old discovered pilot from the early days of Benedict and Gaz, found in a mislabelled tin at the back of the management's stationery cupboard and shown here in vision, regrettably. The programme acquires a Caribbean correspondent, Miss Dorothea Campbell. Benedict cannot follow a word she says. Gaz can. She cannot follow Gaz. There is some cricket, a note from the management, and a lift that was never once held.

A short film, in vision. Pictures and performances generated by machine; nobody in it exists, and nothing in it happened.
